derivation_principles: Target causal and structural under-specification rather than cosmetic improvement of Attempt-1 outputs.
Do not make the future renderer prompt a longer style essay; keep the compiler thin and select only the controls relevant to each tier.
Treat correctness and experiment isolation as hard contracts; keep aesthetic quality under human authority.
Preserve negative evidence without promoting one attempt into a global taste rule or global compiler defect.
Keep Style Capsule V1 immutable and create any future V1.1 candidate as a new artifact with explicit lineage.

requirements.title: Freeze Style Capsule V1 as the immutable Attempt-1 baseline
requirements: Do not mutate evidence/vpd/shanyeji/style_capsule_v1/STYLE_CAPSULE_V1.json.
A future V1.1 candidate must be a new artifact/version with explicit V1 plus Attempt-1 failure-evidence lineage.
V1 remains a valid historical formal capsule baseline but is not validated as a durable family signature.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Exact V1 SHA remains f47023656ad0b5d2b0fe374bd90533f65987ef11175cded20ba37fdf82f3f8f1 and the future candidate references this baseline without replacement.

requirements.title: Surface-token bundles are not sufficient family evidence
non_sufficient_surface_observations: wok in lower or right region
requirements: Encode these as surface observations, freedoms or anti-shortcut exclusions rather than family invariants.
A future controlled validation must change several surface observations while preserving the claimed deeper mechanisms.
Repeated surface styling cannot by itself satisfy a FAMILY pass.
requirements.retest_criterion: Surface divergence is present and the reviewer can still identify preserved relational mechanisms without citing the repeated token bundle as the primary evidence.

requirements.title: Separate structural display mass from optional surface treatment
structural_display_mass: glyph-group balance as one visual object
local edge or crop interaction where appropriate
requirements: Brush-calligraphy and faux ink must not be the default implementation.
Texture alone must never satisfy authored display mass.
Structural properties must remain judgeable when surface texture is removed or materially changed.
requirements.retest_criterion: The title's combined object behavior and counter-mass relation remain explainable independently of brush, ink, erosion or distress.

requirements.title: Define held constants, changed variables and prohibited leakage per tier

prohibited_leakage: generic mountain or restaurant token used as process evidence
simple crop, stretch or stack-only adaptation

requirements.automatic_failure_rule: If a later tier's defining content appears in an earlier tier, operator isolation fails automatically.
requirements.retest_criterion: All tier outputs satisfy their machine-readable HELD_CONSTANTS, CHANGED_VARIABLES and PROHIBITED_LEAKAGE records.

requirements.title: Encode relational topology rather than fixed screen coordinates
preserve_relationships: dominant title mass <-> active photographic counter-mass
high-detail photo region <-> lower graphic density
do_not_encode: quiet tonal pocket has a fixed location
requirements.retest_criterion: Outputs may move all major masses while retaining the relation graph and locally safe information placement.

requirements.title: ASPECT_ADAPT must reallocate zones and preserve a reading-order graph
requirements: Allocate title, photographic action, support and closure zones according to the target aspect.
Reflow title/photo/support relationships rather than preserve original coordinates.
Preserve first/second/third-read order as a graph.
Prevent generic center-stacked and giant-vertical-calligraphy fallback.
Optional information may move or reduce; filler information may not be invented.
Do not add semantic motifs merely to occupy vertical space.
requirements.retest_criterion: With F2 content fixed, the new aspect shows native zone reallocation and relationship reflow without decorative filler.

requirements.title: Motif default is omission unless causally justified
requirements: Set motif default to OMIT.
A retained motif must derive from the new subject, process or identity semantics.
A retained motif must perform a named hierarchy, counterweight or semantic function that can be reviewed.
Decorative mountain, badge, path, seal and scribble tokens are prohibited as generic family markers.
requirements.negative_evidence: The unnecessary F3 mountain-line graphic is preserved as evidence of semantic/surface shortcutting.
requirements.retest_criterion: Every motif is either absent or has an explicit subject-derived source and observable compositional function.

requirements.title: Type-safe space must arise from scene and image-design integration
requirements.retest_criterion: Type-safe space changes location across outputs and remains attributable to the photographic composition rather than a repeated overlay template.

requirements.title: Require bounded surface divergence across future FAMILY outputs
requirements: Do not require maximum diversity in every field.
Require enough meaningful divergence that one obvious visual template cannot satisfy all tiers.
Repeated surface styling is not evidence of family transfer.
requirements.retest_criterion: The future experiment records its intended divergence matrix before generation and human review confirms that multiple surface fields actually diverged.

requirements.title: Family similarity must be explainable through causal relationships
requirements: A future reviewer must name the preserved hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal-space, density or depth relationships.
If family resemblance cannot be explained without relying mainly on surface-token references, formal FAMILY validation fails.

requirements.title: Photographic realism cannot compensate for mechanism collapse
requirements: Retain food, hand, wok, material, light and depth realism constraints.
Score technical photographic realism separately from FAMILY mechanism evidence.
Do not turn V1.1 into a longer food-photography quality prompt.
A realism pass cannot override operator-isolation, topology, motif or aspect failures.
requirements.attempt1_evidence: F2 has the strongest photographic realism but the overall formal FAMILY validation still fails.

requirements.title: Keep refinements Capsule-local unless independent evidence proves a compiler defect
requirements: Do not modify the global Visual Distillation Compiler in this settlement or the future V1.1 candidate creation task.
Record any suspected global issue only as GLOBAL_COMPILER_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY.
Require independent cross-capsule evidence before proposing a global compiler change.

future_candidate_constraints.prompt_compiler_boundary: Keep future compiled renderer instructions compact and select only tier-relevant high-leverage controls; do not serialize this requirements document as a prompt.
